name: @natlang/semantic-etl
description: Map drifting vendor feeds into a strict schema: a model-built row mapping verified on samples runs crisply over every row; only anomalous rows reach the model.

semantic-etl.description: Run Semantic ETL from a JSON file, stdin, or --rows/--schema/--expectedTotal/--entityLink arguments.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to a JSON file containing { rows, schema?, expectedTotal?, entityLink?, options? }.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.description: Raw incoming vendor rows to normalize.

arguments.name: entityLink
arguments.description: Optional entity records to link via semanticMatch.
